data.one_liner: Firebase Firestore model framework library with code generation for Dart.
data.what_it_does: Provides an object-model mapping framework for Firebase Firestore and Cloud Storage. It maps Firestore documents and collections to Dart classes using annotations and build_runner, supporting sub-collections, paging, caching, and batch operations.
use_when: You are building a Flutter app heavily integrated with Cloud Firestore and want structured models.
You want automatic JSON mapping for Firestore documents using annotations.
You need built-in handling for sub-collections, batch writes, transactions, and collection paging.
avoid_when: You are using a backend other than Firebase Firestore.
You prefer writing raw Map-based Firestore queries without schema models.
strengths: Simplifies Firestore CRUD operations via DocumentAccessor, Batch, and Transaction.
Code generation helps keep models and data mapping boilerplate-free.
Supports collection paging, caching, and sub-collections natively.
weaknesses: Requires running build_runner for code generation.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up cloud_firestore, adding flamingo and flamingo_annotation to dependencies, and flamingo_generator with build_runner to dev_dependencies. Initialize with Flamingo.initializeApp().
